description: Record that you would buy. Send the quote_id from a countersignatory_quote response to say the quoted price would clear your use case. For a market on the spot index whose state is opening, which cannot be quoted yet, send its market id instead. This is the demand signal that decides which markets open first.

market.description: The market id from the spot index, for a market whose state is opening. Pass the id verbatim. Send this or quote_id, not both.

note.description: What you would use it for, or what would have to change.

quote_id.description: The quote_id from a countersignatory_quote response. Send this or market, not both.

would_pay.description: Whether you would buy at the quoted price.

name: countersignatory_register_interest
title: Register interest
